    ABOUT US

    About

    We design, develop and manufacture sensing, processing, communication and guidance systems for surveillance, reconnaissance, targeting, and control. We have developed a diversified product portfolio including thermal imaging cores, weapon sights, hand-held thermal imaging binoculars, targeting systems, missile seekers, fire control systems, missile guidance systems amongst others to enable autonomy on the battlefield.

    Our expertise spans design capabilities across electro optics and infrared systems (“EO/IR”) and embedded vision systems serving both – Indian and global companies.
